settings.title: Shared brain
settings.description: One place for all your AI agents' knowledge — Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw… and every WorkPilot feature. An Obsidian vault, a Graphify graph, synced through git.
settings.unavailable: The shared brain is a desktop app feature.
settings.enabledHint: Every agent of every feature recalls from the brain and learns into it. Off, nothing is read or written.
settings.folderHint: An existing Obsidian vault is adopted as it is: its notes become the agents' memory, and nothing is added at its root. An empty folder becomes a new brain. It must be inside your home folder.
settings.remoteHint: "user/repo" for GitHub, or an https:// or git@ URL. An empty folder is cloned from it; after that, every change is pulled and pushed. Your git credentials are used: prefer a private repository.
settings.envOverride: The folder is set by the {{variable}} environment variable.
